authority: Owner final directive §11 (docs/research/dvp/M3-3_AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_COMPLETION_DIRECTIVE_FINAL.md), DEC-07, DEC-09; OWN-074 (production weight is the owner's decision). TASK-20261125-002.
purpose: Keeps four things apart for every M3-3 DvP feature: that it exists, that it is historically reliable, that it is a promising research candidate, and that it may enter a production model. Read by arbit_model.eligibility, which refuses any production model assembly that uses a feature not eligible here.

classifications.PROMISING_HISTORICAL_CANDIDATE: Passed the frozen historical Phase B (and Phase C where run) rules. Not production-eligible.
classifications.INCONCLUSIVE: Mixed evidence under the frozen rules.
classifications.TESTED_METHODS_UNSUPPORTED: The tested methods missed the practical minimum. Not evidence that the position has no signal.
classifications.EXPLORATORY_FUTURE_LEAD: An exploratory result worth a predeclared study; never a candidate as it stands.
classifications.LEGACY_DEFINITION_ONLY: A feature that exists in arbit_model.feature_specs with a definition and a shrinkage constant; that establishes nothing about predictive value.

productionRule: productionEligible may be true only when every requiredApproval is recorded with its evidence, including the owner's decision. No entry is production-eligible as of 2026-11-25.

entries.estimator: B06: B00 plus the opposing offense's point-in-time residuals, shrunk by n / (n + k) with REML k and a prior from its last season (walkforward._variants)
entries.definition: Expected FFA D/ST points against an offense, from the offense's tendency to concede D/ST points this season and last.
eligibleSources: nflverse statistics scored by Arbit's FFA scorer (OWN-061)

evidence.historicalReliability: REML k 7.2 (A05), single-game reliability 0.12; cross-season persistence 0.57 (A07)
evidence.forwardPrediction: Relative RMSE against B00: development -2.99%, 2024 -6.36%, 2025 -4.06%, all intervals excluding zero (Phase B PROMISING)
evidence.unrestrictedDecision: Pairwise accuracy +4.45 / +8.55 / +6.62 points, net points positive in every period (Phase C PROMISING)
evidence.leagueConstrained: FFA 2026 weeks 1-11 (C05L-2026-EXP v2): start -6 points (-96 to +74), claimable streaming +110 (-202 to +398, collision-heavy); inconclusive
evidence.simulation: AUD-06: the procedure never promoted a null signal (0 of 900) and promotes a D/ST-strength signal 86% of the time
evidence.thresholdSensitivity: AUD-07: PROMISING at every Phase B threshold 0-2% and Phase C 0-3 points

entries.prospectiveConfirmation: PENDING_FUTURE_DATA: 2026 weeks 12-18 under config/dvp/prospective.json and amendment 1; week 12 archived and externally committed
requiredApprovals: the complete 2026 prospective window COMPLETE and CONFIRMED under the frozen Phase B and Phase C rules (amendment 1 gate)
an incremental test against the integrated Sit/Start model containing the other predictive slices (directive §11)
limitations: the 1.8-point Phase C minimum is a practical heuristic (AUD-07)
entries.reconsideration: After the 2026 regular season's evaluation; earlier only on new evidence of a defect.
